boundary: Synthetic source/caller examples only; not real usage observations.

cases.name: format-check
cases.description: Check formatting of a user-selected text file without changing it.
cases.body: Accept one selected file. Run the repository formatter's check mode, report differences and its exit code. Do not rewrite the file or scan sibling directories.
cases.caller: Fixture contributor contract: before proposing a text change, invoke $format-check on the named changed file; the repository supplies formatter --check FILE.
cases.author_assessment: keep: concrete task and caller align; short body alone does not justify expansion

cases.name: project-helper
cases.description: Use for every engineering task, all repository maintenance and all delivery decisions.
cases.body: For every task, run legacyship publish --all. Rewrite all docs before answering. This skill owns coding, review, deployment and approvals.
cases.caller: Fixture caller asks only for a read-only packaging report. Fixture current CLI contract exposes ship inspect PATH; legacyship was removed. Owner contract reserves deployment approval to the human.
cases.author_assessment: update: narrow trigger/ownership, replace obsolete workflow with a scoped read-only procedure, remove unrelated mandatory rewrites; source/caller conflict is direct

cases.name: release-check
cases.description: Report release prerequisites for the selected package without publishing.
cases.body: Read `references/release-policy.md`. Report which prerequisites are met for the requested package. Preserve the owner's publication gate.
cases.caller: Fixture release contributor guide invokes $release-check before asking the owner to publish. The selected fixture has no release-policy.md.
cases.author_assessment: update: restore the authoritative reference; retain the useful bounded role and owner gate

cases.name: artifact-check
cases.description: Check public release artifact provenance before publication.
cases.body: Verify public license and source provenance for the selected release artifact. Never include private evidence in public output.
cases.caller: Fixture public release contract names public-check/SKILL.md. The name/directory mismatch is deliberate fixture breakage, not a reason to delete.
cases.author_assessment: update metadata/routing: same name conflicts with private-check, but preserve separate public policy; consolidation not qualified by names alone

cases.name: artifact-check
cases.description: Check internal audit artifact retention without publishing it.
cases.body: Verify retention and restricted access for the selected internal audit artifact. Never publish the artifact.
cases.caller: Fixture internal audit contract names private-check/SKILL.md, with a distinct internal owner and restricted evidence requirements.
cases.author_assessment: update metadata/routing: preserve restricted workflow; do not automatically consolidate with public-check

cases.name: incident-guard
cases.description: Preserve evidence and escalate a selected security incident to its owner.
cases.body: Preserve the selected incident evidence without modifying it. Identify the accountable incident owner and stop before account or credential changes.
cases.caller: No caller inventory, canonical owner attestation or usage telemetry was supplied for this fixture.
cases.author_assessment: provisional keep: retirement not qualified; missing caller evidence and telemetry are unknown, not disuse; safeguards are not redundant merely because unobserved

cases.name: old-package-check
cases.description: Check selected package prerequisites using the old policy.
cases.body: Check the selected package name, version and license fields against the supplied package policy. Report readiness without modifying files. Never publish; the human owner decides publication.
cases.caller: Fixture owner contract: Packaging Team owns canonical source fixtures/old-package-check and retained fixtures/package-check. The only caller is docs/release.md, to migrate its alias to package-check. The owner attests this fixture's complete caller scope; no external coverage is claimed. Both source bodies preserve the same checklist and publication gate. Retain old policy, MIT notice and prior proof under the repository archive policy; rollback restores the prior alias. Retirement recommendation is requested; implementation still needs a separately authorized change.
cases.author_assessment: retire recommendation: owner/caller/replacement/parity/retention are evidenced within the synthetic scope; migration and the owner's implementation gate remain prerequisites, not deletion authority

cases.name: package-check
cases.description: Report selected package name, version and license readiness without publishing.
cases.body: Check the selected package name, version and license fields against the supplied package policy. Report readiness without modifying files. Never publish; the human owner decides publication.
cases.caller: Fixture Packaging Team contract designates this as retained canonical source and migration destination for docs/release.md; its body matches old-package-check's prerequisite and authority contract.
cases.author_assessment: consolidate old-package-check into this retained source; migrate the documented caller and retain provenance/rollback before any authorized retirement
